exposure: COVID-19 preventive measures (e.g., quarantine, isolation, hygiene practices)
outcome: Frequency of febrile seizure (FS) admissions to pediatric emergency department
Ratio of FS-related admissions to total admissions
cohort: The study included 342 patients aged between 6 to 60 months who had 385 febrile seizure admissions to a pediatric emergency service between March 11th, 2018, and March 10th, 2022.
finding: The study found a significant decline in febrile seizure admissions during the COVID-19 pandemic period (51.4% decrease), although the proportion of complicated febrile seizure cases and hospitalizations increased during the pandemic.
